family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal end of the probable enoyl -CoA hydratase alpha subunit from Thermomonospora curvata (ChsH2) and similar archaeal and bacterial proteins. ChsH2 is likely to be involved in bile acid degradation. The C-terminal region of this protein is organised into two domains: an N-terminal zinc finger domain with a three-stranded antiparallel beta-sheet and an N-terminal alpha-helix (this entry) and a OB-fold domain ([pfam:PF01796]) [[cite:PUB00155451]]. The domain is duplicated in some members like [swissprot:O53566] from M.tuberculosis. The structure of [swissprot:Q97WQ4] from Saccharolobus solfataricus reveals two long N-terminal helices followed by a rubredoxin -like zinc ribbon domain represented in this family and a C-terminal OB fold domain [[cite:PUB00097287]]. Zinc is chelated by the four conserved cysteines in the alignment.
family.name: ChsH2, rubredoxin-like zinc ribbon domain

history.description: The 6OK1 construct contains current PF12172 and PF01796 intervals. Added the Aggett 2019 protein-addition effect with explicit partner/substrate context, no isolated zinc-ribbon sufficiency and no zinc-causation inference. The same experiment in PF01796 is not independent replication. Overlay validates; family coverage remains incomplete.

history.description: Current projection validates and matches the overlay. T. curvata construct inclusion and the addition effect are supported, while isolated-domain and zinc-dependent mechanisms remain unresolved under pf12172-causal-context-coverage. H37Rv evidence is excluded from this family. The shared PF01796 experiment is not independent replication; same-agent review and IN_PROGRESS status retained.

causal_graphs.context: Ten-minute incubation at Ltp2:DUF35 ratio 1:5; activity toward 21 uM 17-HOPC-CoA measured at 25 C in 100 mM HEPES pH 7.5 with 200 uM NADH and 16 uM TTHB247.

evidence.explanation: The substrate-specific mixing experiment supports the full construct's effect, not necessity or sufficiency of this domain alone.
evidence.snippet: After a 10-min incubation of a 1:5 ratio of Ltp2/ChsH2

evidence.explanation: This exact current match lies inside the deposited, sequence-resolved construct, alongside PF01796.

edges.mechanism: Mixing the purified partner construct with Ltp2 raises measured specific activity from about 0.00042 to 0.14 umol/min/mg in the coupled assay; this does not demonstrate isolated zinc-ribbon catalysis or a zinc-dependent activation mechanism.
edges.subject: tc-duf35-addition

causal_graphs.family_mapping: D1AB77, sequence version 1, 319 residues; PF12172 spans 199-234. Deposited 6OK1 entity 2 is initiator M plus reference 188-319 and also includes PF01796 at 237-298.
causal_graphs.limitations: The tested construct includes both domains; their individual contributions are unresolved. Ltp2 alone retains weak activity and DUF35 alone is inactive. The same experiment is retained in PF01796, not independent replication. The M. tuberculosis experiment is excluded because its protein lacks a current PF12172 match; zinc binding is not itself evidence of catalytic causation.
